description: EquiMind master config for triggers, tools, and trigger-to-tool mapping (including competition nerves, low energy, and context).

triggers.name: High Anxiety
triggers.description: Rider reports high anxiety, fear, or intense nervousness (for example, 8–10 on a 1–10 scale).
triggers.notes_for_ui: Your anxiety is high right now. Let's help your body and mind settle so you and your horse feel safer.

triggers.name: Anxiety Increased
triggers.description: Rider reports a noticeable increase in anxiety from their baseline, but not at peak level yet.
triggers.notes_for_ui: You've noticed your anxiety creeping up. This is a great time to ground before it spikes.

triggers.name: Low Confidence
triggers.description: Rider reports generally low belief in their abilities or skills for this ride.
triggers.notes_for_ui: You're not feeling very confident. Let's build up your sense of capability step by step.

triggers.name: Confidence Decreased
triggers.description: Rider feels a recent drop in confidence compared to their usual level.
triggers.notes_for_ui: Your confidence has dipped. Let's process what happened and support you in getting it back.

triggers.name: High Anxiety + Low Confidence
triggers.description: Rider reports both high anxiety and low confidence at the same time.
triggers.notes_for_ui: You're feeling both anxious and unsure. We'll slow things down and co-regulate you and your horse together.

triggers.name: High Horse Energy + Low Rider Confidence
triggers.description: Horse is high energy or reactive while the rider reports low confidence.
triggers.notes_for_ui: Your horse is feeling spicy and your confidence is low. Let's focus on body awareness and safety together.

triggers.name: Low Horse Focus
triggers.description: Horse seems distracted, tense, or not tuned in to the rider.
triggers.notes_for_ui: Your horse's focus is scattered. We'll use tools to release tension and reconnect.

triggers.name: Optimal Performance
triggers.description: Rider feels 'in the zone' or near their best performance state.
triggers.notes_for_ui: You're in a really solid place. We'll help you reinforce this flow state.

triggers.name: Good Improvement
triggers.description: Rider notices clear progress or positive change compared to previous rides.
triggers.notes_for_ui: You've made good progress. Let's highlight and reinforce what's working.

triggers.name: Optimal Horse Metrics
triggers.description: Horse is moving, responding, or recovering in ways that meet or exceed goals or expected metrics.
triggers.notes_for_ui: Your horse is giving you really good data today. We'll sync your mindset with their performance.

triggers.name: Default / General Exploration
triggers.description: Used when no specific trigger is detected or the rider wants to browse general tools.
triggers.notes_for_ui: Not sure where to start? Let's explore some tools together.

triggers.name: High Confidence + High Anxiety (Competition Nerves)
triggers.description: Rider reports feeling confident in skills but noticeably nervous, buzzing, or keyed up. A high-confidence, high-anxiety competition state where arousal needs to be balanced, not eliminated.
triggers.notes_for_ui: You feel capable, but your nerves are high. Let's channel that energy into focus instead of overwhelm.

triggers.name: Low Energy / Low Motivation (Apathy or Exhaustion)
triggers.description: Rider feels flat, tired, unmotivated, or emotionally drained. Not primarily anxious or scared—more depleted, apathetic, or low-drive.
triggers.notes_for_ui: You're not broken—you're tired. Let's gently build a bit of momentum and reconnect with why you ride.

triggers.name: Competition vs Training Context
triggers.description: Distinguishes whether the rider is currently in a show/competition setting or a schooling/training ride. The same emotional state will get different tools depending on this context.
triggers.notes_for_ui: Are you in show mode or training mode right now? This helps match tools to what today actually looks like.
